report:
Mediales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Oberflächliche Knorpelirregularität an der medialen Femurcondyle (Serie 4/ Image 24). Kein teifergreifender/vollschichtiger Knorpeldefekt. In Korrelation zu der konventionellen Röntgenaufnahme vom [DATE] geringe Chondrokalzinose. Intakter Innenmeniskus. Partialläsion des MCL (Grad 2).

Laterales Kompartiment:
Lineares Bone-bruise im dorsolateralen Femurcondylus. Keine Fraktur. Oberflächliche Knorpelirregularität am lateralen Tibiaplateau (Serie 4/ Image 23). In Korrelation zu der konventionellen Röntgenaufnahme vom [DATE] geringe Chondrokalzinose. Kein tiefergreifender/vollschichtiger Knorpeldefekt. Intakter Außenmeniskus. Intaktes LCL.

Femoropatellares Gleitlager und Trochlea:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Fokaler tieferschichtiger Knorpeldefekt an der medialen Patellafacette (Serie 3/ Image 50) sowie oberflächliche Knorpelirregularitäten an der oberen lateralen Patellafacette (Serie 7/ Image 13). Kein subchondrales Ödem. Ansonsten intakter Knorpel. Regelrechte Darstellung der Quadrizeps- und Patellarsehne. Regelrechte Darstellung des Hoffa`schen Fettkörpers.

Kreuzbänder:
Intakte Kreuzbänder.

Muskulatur und übrige Weichteile:
Kleine Plica mediopatellaris. Ausgedehnter Hämarthros. Diffuse Flüssigkeitsstraßen im subkutanen Fettgewebe des Kniegelenks. Varikös erweiterte Venen im subkutanen Fettgewebe medialseitig.

Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif derecede artmış. Arka çapraz ve iç yan bağ normal. Dış yan bağın femoral yapışma yeri düzeyindeki kalınlaşma ve intensite artışı kronik zorlanma ile uyumlu. Ön çapraz bağın intensitesi difüz olarak artmış olup orta kesiminde komplet yırtık mevcut. Medyal menisküs arka boynuzdan gövdesine uzanan longitudinal yırtık arka boynuz düzeyinde vertikal, gövdesi düzeyinde ise oblik seyir gösteriyor. Ön boynuz düzeyinde serbest kenarda radyal yırtık da eşlik ediyor. Lateral menisküs normal. Diz eklemindeki hafif dereceli osteoartrit patella apeksi ve medyal fasetindeki milimetrik kondral fissürler, medyal femoral kondilin ağırlık taşıyan yüzeyindeki yüzeyel kondral düzensizlikler ve milimetrik boyutlu marjinal osteofitler ile karakterize. Gastroknemyus, semimembranozus bursasındaki sıvı koleksiyonu 6 cm maksimum boyutlu ve sızdırmıyor. Popliteus tendonu normal. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş. Proksimal tibyofibular eklem normal.

SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs  normaldir. Medial menisküs arka boynuz kök lokalizasyonunda yırtık izlenmekte olup menisküste hafif ekstrüzyon görülmektedir.Menisküs gövde kesiminde grade II dejenerasyon izlendi.Medial eklem aralığında komşu femur ve tibiada marjin osteofitler görülmektedir.Medial eklem aralığında komşu ve femur ve tibiada tam kat kıkırdak kaybı mevcuttur.Ön çapraz bağ ve arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Distal kuadriseps  normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Patellar lateral fasette fibrulasyon gözlendi.Trohlear kartilaj anterior kesimde grade II dejenerasyon alanları izlendi.Popliteus tendonu içerisinde minimal mayii mevcuttur.Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapıların sinyal intensiteleri doğaldır.SONUÇ: Medial menisküs arka boynuz kök yırtığı ve eşlik eden meniskal ekstrüzyon, medial eklem aralığında marjin osteofitler, medial ve tibial kondromalazi.

MRI of right  Knee with 
-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS

* Interstitial hyperintensity signal of ACL, in favor of grade 1 injury.
* Interstitial hyperintensity signal of MCL, medial patellar retinaculum and laxity of the deep fibers, R/O partial tear.
* Interstitial increased signal intensity of quadriceps tendon on F/S T2WI, in favor of grade 1 injury; subcutaneous edema over anterior aspect of right knee
* Bone marrow edema in posterior lateral tibial plateua, in favor of bone contusion.
* Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar and medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
> No evidence of tear is noted in either medial or lateral meniscus in this study.
> The contour of PCL and LCL appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> The lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.

Impression:
1. C/W grade 2 injury (partial tear) of MCL.
2. Grade 1 injury of ACL.
3. Grade 1 strain of Quadriceps tendon
4. Bone contusion of right posterior lateral tibial plateua.
5. Suprapatellar bursitis and mild synovitis of right knee and patellar plicae.
6. Subcutaneous edema over anterior and medial aspect of right knee.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation.

Innenmeniskus ausgefranst mit Substanzdefekt v.a. im Hinterhorn bei in die Notch umgeschlagenen Korbhenkel links riss (6/13). Außenmeniskus intakt. VKB gering mukoid. HKB regelrecht und intakt. Flächig vollschichtiger Chondropathie beider Gelenkpartner im medialen Kniegelenk, in der Belastungszone mit teils beginnenden Deformitäten und insbesondere randständig subchondralen Ödemzonen. Bei im Röntgen V.a. SIF hier kleine subchondrale Ödemzone zentral femoral (5/24) ohne umschriebene Frakturlinie. Geringe oberflächliche Chondropathie lateralseitig, Außenmeniskus intakt. Retropatellar neben oberflächlichen Chondropathien hochgradige Arthrose mediokranial mit subchondraler Ödembildung und chondralen Osteophyten. MCL mit ausgedehntem Reizzustand. Mäßiger Gelenkerguss mit deutlich flüssigkeitsgefüllter Baker-Zyste (CC 7,2 cm, 6/9). Kleine Plica mediopatellaris. Reizsynovialitis. Unauffällige Darstellung der Quadrizepssehne sowie des Ligamentum patellae. Umgebend diffuse Flüssigkeitseinlagerungen subkutan, betont in den dorsalen Anteilen.

The study shows geographic T2 hyperintense double line sign, representing osteonecrosis at along weight-baring, non weight-baring medial and lateral femoral condyles. There is no articular collapse. No surrounding marrow edema. 
 In the medial compartment, there are radial tears at the anterior horn and body of the medial meniscus. There is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The lateral compartment, appears normal including meniscus. The articular cartilage appears normal. 
 The patellofemoral joint, there is diffuse low grade and high grade chondrosis (less than and more than 50% thickness cartilage loss) along medial, lateral patellar facets, medial and lateral trochleas. There is no subchondral edema. Osteophytes are present. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
 There is complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact. There is no tibial translation. 
 The medial and lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. 
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 Minimal amount of left knee effusion is present. The surrounding musculature is normal.  -- Osteonecrosis at non weight-baring, weight-baring medial, lateral femoral condyles. (note: no articular collaspe).  
 -- Mild medial tibiofemoral compartmental osteoarthritis of the left knee by evidence of chondrosis and small osteophytes. 
 -- Complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. 
 -- Minimal amount of left knee effusion.

MRI of right Knee with 
-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS, SG T1W



> The contour of PCL is not in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside on F/S T2WI, in favor of tear.
> The contour of MCL not all in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside on F/S T2WI, in favor of grade 2 injury.
  Mild interstitial increased signal of ACL and proximal LCL on F/S T2WI, in favor of grade 1 injury.
> Linear signal intensity in anterior and posterior horn of medial meniscus, with extending into the surface, in favor of tear; in favor of adjacent parameniscal cyst.
> Linear signal intensity in lateral meniscus, without significant extending into the surface, in favor of grade 2 intrasubstance signal, maybe due to degeneration.
> Subcutaneous infiltration over right knee.
> Increased fat stranding and minimal fluid accumulation located along the pes anserinus, R/O Anserine bursitis
  Small Baker's cyst.
> Mild tendinosis of iliotibial band and quadriceps tendon.

Impression: 
1. Tear of medial meniscus with parameniscal cyst.
   Degeneration of lateral meniscus.
2. Tear of PCL.
3. Grade 2 injury of MCL.
4. Grade 1 injury of ACL and LCL.
5. Anserine bursitis.
6. Synovitis of right knee and suprapatellar bursitis and patellar plicae; small Baker's cyst and popliteus bursitis.
7. Subcutaneous edema over right knee.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs  normaldir.  Medial menisküs gövdesinde kompleks yırtık mevcuttur.Anterior çapraz bağda hafif diffüz sinyal artış izlendi.Arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Distal kuadriseps  normaldir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Patellar kıkırdakta  hafif incelme ve komşu kemik yapıda subkondral milimetrik kist izlendi. Eklemde sıvı artışı saptanmamıştır. Medial tibiofemoral eklem düzeyinde minimal marjinal osteofitik dejeneratif değişiklikler izlendi. Diz eklemi çevreleyen komşu yumuşak doku alanlarında ödematöz görünüm mevcuttur.

Interprétation:

Il y a un petit épanchement intra-articulaire avec signes de synovite chronique. Il y a un également un kyste de Baker associé à une prolifération synoviale/synovite chronique s'étendant sur environ 5 cm de diamètre cc. Celui-ci s'étend au niveau des bourses du semi-membraneux et de la patte d'oie avec composante de bursite probablement associée. 

Il y a une déchirure complexe du ménisque interne avec déchirure radiaire transfixiante à la jonction de la racine postérieure et de la corne postérieure, et déchirure longitudinale horizontale impliquant la corne postérieure résiduelle, corps méniscal et s'étendant à la jonction avec la corne antérieure. Il y a une extrusion marquée du corps méniscal de façon associée. De plus, il y a une structure légèrement hétérogène et principalement hypointense ovalaire située de façon intime avec le rebord postérieur de la racine postérieure du ménisque interne mesurant 7 x 14 x 7 mm. L'aspect est plutôt en faveur d'une souris intra-articulaire qui pourrait être en partie ossifiée versus un ossicule méniscal (moins probable). L'aspect est moins en faveur d'un ''flap'' méniscal dont le signal demeure légèrement différent du ménisque et sans continuité démontrée avec la corne postérieure. 

Le ligament collatéral interne est intact sans déchirure. Il y a une atténuation modérée des surfaces cartilagineuses au compartiment fémoro-tibial interne avec atteinte transfixiante aux surfaces portantes et petits ostéophytes marginaux. Pas de changement sous-chondral réactionnel associé. 

Le ménisque externe de même que le complexe ligamentaire collatéral externe sont intacts sans déchirure. 

Légère atténuation diffuse des surfaces cartilagineuses au compartiment fémoro-tibial externe, plus marquée à la surface portante. Petits ostéophytes marginaux.

Les ligaments croisés antérieur et postérieur sont intacts sans déchirure. Petit kyste ganglionnaire para-ligamentaire.

L'alignement patello-fémoral est préservé. Le tendon du quadriceps distal est intact sans déchirure. Légère tendinose du patellaire sans déchirure. 

Atténuation modérée des surfaces chondrales au compartiment patello-fémoral avec fissure chondrale partielle le long de la surface articulaire patellaire et atteinte transfixiante le long de la surface trochléaire. Pas de changement sous-chondral réactionnel associé. Petits ostéophytes marginaux. 

Conclusion:

Déchirure complexe du ménisque interne avec composante radiaire transfixiante à la jonction de la corne postérieure et de la racine postérieure avec extrusion significative du corps méniscal secondairement, de plus, déchirure longitudinale horizontale de la corne postérieure résiduelle et du corps du ménisque interne s'étendant à la jonction avec la corne antérieure.

Changements dégénératifs/chondropathie tricompartimentaux de grade 3 impliquant les compartiments fémoro-tibiaux interne et patello-fémoral et de grade 1 impliquant le compartiment fémoro-tibial externe.

Petit épanchement intra-articulaire et kyste de Baker avec signes de synovite chronique associée. Bursite du semi-membraneux et de la patte d'oie avec également synovite d'allure chronique associée. 

Souris intra-articulaire potentiellement en partie ossifiée au rebord postérieur de la racine postérieure du ménisque interne. Un ossicule méniscal paraît moins probable. L'aspect est moins en faveur d'un ''flap'' méniscal avec un signal différent du ménisque et sans continuité notée avec la corne postérieure du ménisque interne.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Esguince del ligamento colateral medial de la rodilla. Se cuenta un estudio previo para comparar
[DATE].
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones en significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Aumento de señal central del cuerno posterior y cuerpo del menisco medial que no impresiona
contactar con la superficie articular, sin caracteres propios de rotura.
Rotura compleja con componente principal horizontal del cuerpo y cuerno posterior del menisco
lateral con leve extrusión meniscal.
Finas úlceras condrales focales de espesor parcial del platillo tibial lateral en su región central.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial de la región central de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral
medial.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y total de predominio lateral de la articulación patelofemoral
con cambios óseos secundarios.
Mínimo derrame articular. No hay quistes poplíteos patológicos.
Tendones cuadricipital, rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial
sin alteraciones. Discreto aumento de señal del aspecto superoexterno de la grasa de Hoffa.
Impresión:
Rotura compleja del menisco lateral con leve extrusión meniscal.
Condropatía lesiones grado 2 de platillo tibial lateral y el cóndilo femoral medial.
Condropatía lesiones focales grado 3 y 4 de la articulación patelofemoral.
Mínimo derrame articular.
Discretos fenómenos de hiperpresión externa de la rótula

Regelrechte Artikulations- und Stellungsverhältnisse im Kniegelenk. Keine relevanten Degenerationen. Allseits regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Kein Hinweis auf eine Fraktur oder ein Bone-bruise. Geringe Chondropathie an der medialen Patellafacette, ansonsten keine höhergradige Chondropathie femoropatellar und femorotibial. Vorderes und hinteres Kreuzband sowie Kollateralbänder intakt. Quadrizeps- und Patellarsehne intakt ohne Signalalteration. Wurzelnahe Rissbildung des Innenmeniskus (4/23). Innemeniskus partiell zur Notch umgeschlagen, DD bei älterem Korbhenkelriss (4/19). Regelrechte Konfiguration des Außenmeniskus ohne H.a. Rissbildung. Mäßiger Gelenkerguss. Unauffällige Darstellung der Weichteile.

Findings:  There is a mild - moderate knee effusion. A small collapsed Baker's cyst is noted.  There is incomplete tearing of the posterior root of the medial meniscus with partial extrusion from the joint. Normal lateral meniscus.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  There is mild - moderate thinning of the medial compartment articular cartilage but no significant underlying bony change. Normal lateral tibiofemoral and patellofemoral articular cartilage. Normal visualized remaining bone and surrounding soft tissues.  Conclusion: No significant popliteal cyst identified. Mild - moderate medial compartment degeneration. Incomplete tearing of the posterior root of the medial meniscus.

Technique: MRI of the knee. MCL normal. ACL normal. Degenerative changes of medial meniscus. Lateral meniscus normal. Chondromalacia of patelofemoral compartment. No effusion. No baker's cyst.  Conclusion: Chondromalacia of all patelofemoral compartment. Degenerative changes of medial meniscus.

Kleine osteophytäre Randkantenausziehungen femorotibial bds.. Partiell vollschichtiger Chondropathie im medialen femorotibialen Kompartiment ohne Belastungsödem. Chondropathie °II-III der medialen Patellafacette. Mäßiger Gelenkerguss, Bakerzyste. Unauffällige Darstellung von HKB und VKB, ebenso der Kollateralbänder. Bei teils mukoiden Signalanhebungen keine Ruptur der Menisci.

Erhaltene Artikulation im rechten Kniegelenk. Patella zentriert stehend. Fokaler hochgradiger Knorpeldefekt bis zum Knochen reichend an der medialen Patellafacette mit ca. 4 mm Breite (7/6). Im darunterliegenden Knochen angrenzendes Ödem (4/9). Ansonsten unauffällige Darstellung des femoropatellaren Kompartiments. Fabella.
Femorotibial medialseitig allenfalls geringe oberflächliche Chondropathie bei ansonsten erhaltenen Knorpelbelag. I.e.L. degenerativer Horizontalriss des Innenmeniskushinterhorns mit Auslaufen in die Pars intermedia (5/9). Vorderes und hinteres Kreuzband durchgehend abgrenzbar. Unauffällige Darstellung des Kollateralbandapparates. Kein Gelenkerguss. Unauffällige Darstellung der umgebenden Muskulatur und Subkutis.

SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküste grade II dejenerasyon izlendi. Medial menisküste grade II dejenerasyon izlendi. Ön çapraz bağ ve arka çapraz bağ, lateral  kollateral ligaman normaldir .Medial kollateral ligamen hafif ödemlidir ( grade I sprain ). Patellar tendon normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinakulumlar normal izlendi. Patellar kıkırdakta yer yer hipointens değişiklikler ve fissur hatları izlenmiştir ( grade II kondromalazi ). Suprapatellar bursada diz eklemi içerisinde sıvı artışı izlendi. İnfrapatellar yağ yastıkçığında ödem izlendi.Femur lateral kondil düzeyinde yaklaşık 6 mm çaplı, T1 ve T2 A serilerde sklerotik lezyon izlendi ( kemik adacığı ).Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapıların sinyalleri normaldir.Prepatellar düzeyde cilt altı yağlı dokuda ödematöz görünüm mevcuttur.

Findings: There is a minor knee effusion. Normal medial and lateral menisci. No evidence of tears.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  Normal tibiofemoral and patellofemoral articular cartilage. Normal visualized bones and surrounding soft tissues. No evidence of patellar maltracking.  Conclusion: No significant abnormality identified.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Left knee pain for 2 weeks. No known cause.
Comparison: Left knee radiograph dated [DATE]

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions. Large T1/T2 hypointense, cortically based lesion along the distal medial femoral diaphysis with a slightly broader zone of transition in expected, likely represents an old nonossifying fibroma.

JOINT SPACE:
Large joint effusion with increased T1 signal compatible with hemarthrosis, with extensive synovial proliferation, including more focal focal synovitis at the posterosuperior joint space. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: Cartilage thinning, heterogeneity, and fissuring along weightbearing medial femoral condyle tibial plateau.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: High grade partial thickness cartilage loss along the medial patellar facet with focal high grade fissuring.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis. No tendon tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 15 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Sclerotic cortically based lesion along the distal medial femoral diaphysis, likely representing a healed (ossified) nonossifying fibroma. Follow-up radiographs in 3 months recommended to demonstrate stability.
2.	Large knee joint hemarthrosis with extensive synovitis. Given no significant traumatic injury, differential considerations includes pigmented villonodular synovitis (PVNS), coagulopathy, infectious/inflammatory etiologies such as an inflammatory arthropathy or Lyme' s disease.
3.	Medial and patellofemoral compartment chondrosis, as described above.

[REDACTED]. [REDACTED]

Stigmata der medial betonten Pangonarthrose mit osteophytären Anbauten an den Femurkondylen bds., Knochenmarksödem in der medialen Femurkondyle und proximalen, medialen Tibia sowie Ausbildung subchondraler Zysten im medialen Tibiaplateau mit einer Ausdehnung von bis zu 5 x 5 mm (5/17). Knochenmarksödem auch in der dorsolateralen Femurkondyle (5/27) bei hier fokal tiefergreifender Chondropathie (4/11). Ansonsten in den vorliegenden Sequenzen unauffällige Signalgebung der ossären Strukturen. Höhergradig geminderter Knorpelbesatz am proximalen Tibiaplateau mit fokal vollschichtige Chondropathie über eine Ausdehnung von 9 x 19 mm (a.p. x ml, 6/8 sowie 5/20); flächig vollschichtige Chondropathie auch an der medialen Femurkondyle nach medial hin. Keine höhergradige Chondropathie im lateralen Kompartiment. Retropatellar geminderter Knorpelbesatz mit betont an der medialen Trochleafacette höhergradiger Chondropathie ohne fokal vollschichtigen chondralen Defekt. Ausgeprägter Substanzdefekt des Innenmeniskus in der Pars intermedia und im Hinterhorn mit aufgefaserter Struktur sowie radiärem Defekt am Hinterhorn (5/25). Kein Anhalt für eine Rissbildung des Außenmeniskus. VKB sowie HKB intakt. Geringer medialer Reizzustand. LCL mit intakter Signalgebung. Kein Kniegelenkserguss. Kleine, gering flüssigkeitsgefüllte Baker-Zyste. Fabella. 2 Chondrome dorsal. Quadriceps- sowie Patellarsehne mit intakter Signalgebung. Unauffällige Signalgebung der übrigen miterfassten Weichteile in den vorliegenden Sequenzen.

COMPARISON:None.

CLINICAL HISTORY:Traumatic fall 5 months prior. Plain films from mild osteoarthritis, assess for ligamentous/meniscal tear left knee.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence, multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the left knee according to routine protocol.

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

The medial meniscus shows intrasubstance degeneration in the posterior horn and body, without evidence of underlying tear. The lateral meniscus is intact.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

Medial collateral ligament and posterior oblique ligament are intact. The fibular collateral ligament is intact. Popliteus and biceps femoris tendon attachments are intact. Iliotibial band is intact.

The patellar retinacula are intact. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 4 mm, within normal limits. Mild quadriceps insertional tendinosis without tear. Mild proximal patellar tendinosis without tear.

Preserved patellofemoral articular cartilage. There is fissuring of articular cartilage throughout the medial femorotibial compartment, bone weightbearing aspect. Preserved lateral femorotibial articular cartilage.

Small knee joint effusion. Tiny Baker's cyst. Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration. 

IMPRESSION:
1. Mild quadriceps and patellar tendinosis without tear. No evidence of discrete meniscal, ligament, or tendon tear.
2. Mild to moderate medial femorotibial chondrosis suggesting evolving mild medial compartment osteoarthritis left knee.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Pain.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Mild bone marrow edema and cystic changes are present at the tibial spines and at the lateral femoral condyle centrally bordering on the intercondylar notch.. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. Mild, diffuse synovial proliferation. Moderate Baker cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: There is a complex tear involving the posterior horn and body, with a large radial tear at the posterior root attachment. Moderate extrusion.
Medial compartment cartilage: There is mild to moderate cartilage thinning and surface irregularity diffusely. Small osteophytes.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: There is a complex tear involving the anterior and posterior root attachments. Fraying of the inner margin diffusely. No extrusion.
Lateral compartment cartilage: There is mild cartilage thinning at the posterior aspect, with cartilage fissuring centrally near the intercondylar notch.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
